description: Classification of all 1517 ZLU checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 29 ZLU guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement - tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance - tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.triggering-property-verification: Adjacent triggering property (1-3 dwelling units zoned SF-5 or more restrictive) must be identified within required distance
additionalRequirementTypes.adjacent-zoning-verification: Adjacent property zoning designation must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.zoning-district-verification: Applicable zoning district setback requirements must be determined from site development regulations table
additionalRequirementTypes.site-width-verification: Site width must be measured to determine if narrow-site exceptions apply
additionalRequirementTypes.cef-type-verification: Critical Environmental Feature type must be identified to determine applicable buffer distance
additionalRequirementTypes.overlay-verification: Applicable overlay or special district setback requirements must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.planting-specification: Screening zone planting requirements must be verified per 25 linear feet of shared property line
additionalRequirementTypes.unit-count-verification: Residential unit count must be verified for compatibility buffer exception
additionalRequirementTypes.hill-country-verification: Hill Country Roadway corridor designation and intensity zone must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.orientation-identification: Building orientation and compass direction must be identified
